description: This file defines a RuntimeCache class that manages a cache of runtime states keyed by actor keys, including methods for setting, retrieving, and profiling cached runtime data.

classes.name: RuntimeCache
classes.description: A cache management class for runtime states keyed by actor identifiers, providing cache operations and snapshot/idle analysis.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the cache.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a cache entry exists for the specified actor key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the runtime state for a given actor key, optionally touching (updating last accessed time).

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Retrieves the runtime state without updating the last touched timestamp.

methods.name: getLastTouchedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of when the cache entry for the actor key was last touched.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a runtime state in the cache for a specific actor key, updating the last touched time.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes the cache entry for the specified actor key.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns an array snapshot of all cache entries, including idle times based on current timestamp.

methods.name: collectIdleCandidates
methods.description: Filters cache entries that have been idle longer than the specified maximum idle milliseconds.

ctags.name: cache
ctags.pattern: /^  private readonly cache = new Map<string, RuntimeCacheEntry>();$/

fields.name: private readonly cache = new Map<string, RuntimeCacheEntry>();
